description: Captures early signals concepts and opportunity fragments before they disappear.
Stores ideas with taxonomy metadata evidence assumptions and status.
Preserves rationale alternatives tradeoffs dissent and revision triggers.
Connects prototypes pilots and implementation evidence back to ideas.
Preserves stakeholder voice burden legitimacy concerns and redress issues.
Preserves rejected paused or retired ideas with reuse conditions.
Protects strategy knowledge through leadership and personnel transitions.
Uses semantic retrieval and summarization to make institutional memory findable.
